subject: Post-Summit: Observability Partner Impact Metrics & Next Steps
messages:

Cc: Observa Consulting <hello@observa.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability Partner Summit — follow-up & agenda PDF

Hi Laura / Ben,

Great meeting you both at the Partner Summit this morning. I promised to send over the summit slides and a short agenda for the post-summit working group focused on instrumentation and demo metrics. Attached: summit-agenda.pdf (summary + proposed measurement framework).

Two asks from us to keep momentum:
- Can Redwood share 2–3 success metrics you want us to track in a joint PoC (latency P90, ingestion cost delta, and time-to-index)?
- Please nominate a technical lead (engineer) and a product owner for the PoC.

We can offer a week-long joint run with a shared dashboard and a Datadog trial cluster if that helps accelerate validation.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

— Samantha
Samantha Wu
Strategic Partnerships, Datadog
[Attachment: summit-agenda.pdf (PDF)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability Partner Summit — follow-up & agenda PDF

Samantha — thanks, and nice meeting you too. Agenda looks good. Quick answers to your asks and a first pass at KPIs below.

Proposed primary KPIs (we can iterate):
- Application latency P90 (end-to-end inference request) — baseline + post-instrumentation
- Tokenization to response time (ms) — measure framework-level overhead
- Ingestion cost per hour (USD) for telemetry during peak runs
- Feature detection rate for anomalous latencies (precision/recall on synthetic sets)

Technical leads: Ben Carter (eng) <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Product owner: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>.

I've attached a short measurement-template.xlsx (spreadsheet) that maps metrics to ownership and collection signals. Can everyone review and mark any missing measurement hooks?

Next steps we propose:
1) Align on metric definitions by EOD next Tuesday (2026-08-25)
2) Set up the joint demo cluster + sample dataset by 2026-09-02
3) 1-week PoC window during 2026-09-06 to 2026-09-12

If that timeline works, we'll spin up the Redwood-side instrumentation branch and share a lightweight runbook.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: measurement-template.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability Partner Summit — follow-up & agenda PDF

Laura / Samantha — adding a couple of technical notes and a draft MOU.

Technical notes:
- For low-latency paths we'll instrument prefix/KV cache hit counters and per-shard GPU queue latency. Datadog events should be tagged with model_version and route_id.
- We'll push an OTel collector config that forwards to both Datadog and Grafana Loki for log sampling. Sampling policy will be configurable (default: 5% production tails, 100% for synthetic load).

Procurement / MOU: we need a short agreement for sandbox resource sharing and data retention for the trial. I've attached MOU-draft.docx with a 30-day sandbox clause and an approximate cost share. Please review edits.

Action items I can own this week:
- Prepare instrumentation branch and example config (ETA 2026-08-28)
- Coordinate with Infra to request ephemeral GPUs for the demo (ETA 2026-08-30)

Ben
Ben Carter
Partner Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MOU-draft.docx (DOCX)]

Hi all — thanks for looping Grafana in. Quick notes from our side and technical contacts: 

Grafana contacts for the PoC: 
- Priya Kaur (Partner Engineer) priya.kaur@grafana.com
- Tomas Richter (Integrations) tomas.richter@grafana.com

We can provide a pre-built dashboard for model-serving metrics and a Loki ingestion pipeline example. We've also uploaded a starter dashboard and sample JSON to a shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEXAMPLE

- We recommend the PoC include both Datadog and Grafana dashboards for parity; we'll compare ingestion costs and query latency across both.
- Grafana wants to confirm data retention windows for sandbox logs (default 14 days) — that's something to lock in the MOU.

Happy to schedule a joint technical sync — propose Wed 2026-08-26 10:00 PT.

— Grafana Partnerships Team
